headline: OpenAI reports a safety-evaluation gap with production Codex decisions
summary: OpenAI reports that success on its Respecting Warnings safety evaluation was 10.2–37.4 points lower than on selected, structurally comparable decisions sampled from Codex production logs across six served model variants. Evaluation and production model-level success were positively associated, but their absolute rates and exact model ordering differed. In a GPT-6.1 Sol intervention, specifying the evaluation objective shifted reported success sharply in opposite directions, while a generic evaluation cue changed it little. This is a provider-run study with approximate case matching, a six-model cohort and no independent reproduction; it does not establish safety rates for other deployments.
